description: "Popular Scientific Recreations" by Gaston Tissandier is a collection of scientific experiments and principles written in the late 19th century. The work aims to instruct readers on various topics in natural philosophy, astronomy, geology, and chemistry through engaging activities and experiments that can be performed with simple, everyday materials.
